about_the_game:
Star Panic: Cosmic Queens is a cheeky retro-arcade adventure inspired by the classic “reveal” games of the ‘90s. Pilot your nimble starship, capture territory piece by piece, and dodge enemy attacks as you uncover the hidden images behind each stage.

Each level plays out as a tense battlefield. You’ll fly around the edges of the screen, drawing lines to claim sections of space while avoiding projectiles and roaming hazards. The more territory you capture, the more of the stage image is revealed. One hit from an enemy, however, and your ship is destroyed.

Your mission: challenge six powerful and dangerously charming space captains, each with their own unique attack patterns, stage themes, and special mechanics. Outsmart their tricks, survive increasingly difficult challenges, and unlock rewards as you progress through the campaign.

Key Features:

  • Classic “reveal” arcade gameplay with updated visuals and smooth controls

  • Six unique boss characters, each with distinct abilities and themed stages

  • A wide variety of level layouts and hazards that keep the action fresh

  • Unlockable images and rewards for each completed stage

  • A structured campaign with escalating difficulty and strategic depth

  • A playful, adult-themed twist that pays homage to retro arcade games

Fast, flashy, and a little bit naughty, Star Panic: Cosmic Queens blends old-school arcade tension with modern design. Can you outfly the captains and reveal what they’re hiding?

content_descriptors.notes:
The game contains adult content that may not be suitable for all players. Here’s what to expect:

Explicit Sexual Acts: The game includes explicit sexual scenes. These scenes are integral to the narrative and can be graphic in nature, including depictions of nudity.

Violence: There are representations of physical violence, including combat, bloody injuries, and other forms of aggression.

Sexual Violence/Non-Consensual Sex: There are scenes that include themes of sexual violence and non-consensual sex, which may be disturbing to some players.

Psychologically Disturbing Themes: The game contains depictions of mental illness and psychological disorders, including hallucinations and delusions, which may be unsettling for some players.

These elements are intended to create a deep and complex narrative, but they may not be appropriate for everyone. We encourage players to consider these aspects before playing.
